name: Zenith Tempest
description: (Tag:bound)(Tag:electric)(Tag:water)(Tag:weapon)Zenith Tempest, one of the mightiest Longinus, controls weather, atmosphere, and natural elements like fire, wind, lightning, and water to call down lightning, country-wiping storms, and more. A powerful enough user can shred the planet's surface with violent storms. When removed from inventory, it is a small marble that fuses with whoever swallows it.
